item.title: Iran war's global energy crisis sharpens China’s advantage in clean tech

item.summary: Nestled in a high-altitude valley in Afghanistan's Hindu Kush mountain range, Kabul is rapidly running out of water

item.title: Suspected militants kill police officer assigned to guard polio team
item.summary: Suspected militants have opened fire on a vehicle carrying police officers assigned to protect polio workers in northwestern Pakistan, killing one of them and wounding four others

item.title: Haiti arrests 5 police officers and 2 other suspects over deadly fortress stampede
item.summary: Authorities in Haiti have arrested seven suspects, including five police officers, after a fatal stampede killed at least 25 people at a historic mountaintop fortress over the weekend
